implementation_target.ui_runtime: React with a project-owned DOM lifecycle adapter around Milkdown core
implementation_target.persistence: versioned local browser storage behind an Essays-owned repository port

editor_adapter_candidate.name: Milkdown
editor_adapter_candidate.integration_boundary: A project-owned React effect mounts and destroys Milkdown core against a DOM root; no Milkdown React facade or prebuilt editor enters the runtime.

implementation_slices.owns: Domain entities, value objects, operations, rules, events, revision conflicts, validation, export manifests, and stable Markdown block identities.
One local runtime interface exposing every DomainSpec query and operation with typed inputs, outputs, problems, and expected-revision checks.
One clean studio route, non-authoritative view models, explicit lifecycle controls, addressable review rail, visible residue, and export readiness.

A removable four-package Milkdown core adapter evaluated against deterministic CommonMark round-tripping, stable Whisper block anchors, accessibility, exact lockfile licenses, and a denylist-aware bundle inventory.

acceptance_obligations: Every implemented domain or UI concept maps to an exact node in the bound graph; implementation-only framework utilities claim no domain meaning.
The Essays runtime, not React, Milkdown, ProseMirror, or browser storage, owns accepted workspace state and revision transitions.
Generated plans, review observations, and proposed prose never change accepted essay state without an explicit writer operation.
Export is blocked when unresolved blocking review comments or blocking residue remain and never implies publication.
Markdown round-tripping is deterministic for the admitted CommonMark syntax and stable block identities survive admitted edits.
The lockfile and production bundle exclude @milkdown/kit, @milkdown/react, @milkdown/crepe, collaboration, upload, slash, streaming, and other denied surfaces.
Keyboard navigation, visible focus, semantic labels, editor instructions, and review association receive browser evidence.
Unit, integration, deterministic build, DomainSpec recompilation, scoped whitespace, and browser acceptance checks pass.
No network, account, collaboration, publication, deployment, or external synchronization surface is introduced.

owner_routes.system_ontology: Essays Project owner plus DomainSpec v2 owner
owner_routes.editor_adapter: Essays Project owner plus license review owner
owner_routes.whisper: Arcanum Whisper spell owner plus Essays Product Capability owner

challenge_route: Challenge system meaning through the exact graph and bridge owners, implementation boundaries through the Essays runtime owner, Milkdown adoption through the project and license owners, and Whisper behavior through the Whisper spell owner.
drift_rule: Any change to a bound system artifact, implementation target, editor allowlist or denylist, excluded capability, or acceptance obligation creates a new baseline digest and requires renewed owner acceptance.
claim_ceiling: Immutable implementation admission candidate only; no implementation, dependency installation, conformance, runtime adoption, release, publication, deployment, or external effect is authorized until the exact baseline digest is owner-accepted.
